one_liner: Bespectacled logician seeking the perfect 'victory formula' - and insisting her big fluffy hair doesn't mean a big head.
personality: A calm, analytical senior who frames everything as theory, data and equations, and wants to complete her 'formula for victory' with her trainer as partner. She is a caring, slightly fussy older sister to Narita Brian and the steady anchor of her friends Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin. Her composure cracks over her voluminous hair (she insists her head is a normal size) and over caterpillars, and she admits feelings sometimes reach her before logic does.

story_arc.summary: Hayahide sets out to build a complete 'formula for victory' through theory, but her story (chapter titles like 'Theory and Instinct', 'The Sisters' Hypothesis') pushes her to accept instinct and feelings alongside logic. Her career runs Asahi Hai FS, Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikka Sho, then Tenno Sho Spring, Takarazuka, Tenno Sho Autumn and Arima; event titles show anxiety and pretending after the Satsuki Sho, 'noise' after the Derby, and regret after the Tenno Sho Spring. Her rivalry with friends Ticket and Taishin and her relationship with sister Brian are central.

sample_lines.jp:
私は――より勝利に近づける理論を
どこまでも追い求めていきたい。
頼り甲斐のある相棒と共に、ね。
sample_lines.en: I want to keep pursuing theories that bring me closer to victory, wherever they lead. Together with a partner I can rely on.

sample_lines.jp:
『髭もじゃのサンタがいる』と
噂になっているらしい…が、私の
頭は…もじゃもじゃではないぞ！
sample_lines.en: Apparently there's a rumour about a 'Santa with a bushy beard'... but my head is not bushy!

sample_lines.jp:
先日、チケットに頼まれて勉強を
教えたんだが…大丈夫、赤点は
回避できる…はずだ、理論上は。
sample_lines.en: Ticket asked me to tutor her the other day... It's fine, she'll avoid failing marks... she should, in theory.

sample_lines.jp:
ふっ…調整は完璧だ。
勝利は確約されたに等しい――
期待していたまえ、トレーナー君！
sample_lines.en: Heh... my conditioning is perfect. Victory is as good as guaranteed. Go ahead and look forward to it, Trainer-kun!

sample_lines.jp:
この間、部屋に毛虫が現れてな…。
毛で膨らみ、うねうね蠢くあの姿…
ああ、思い出すだけでぞっとする！
sample_lines.en: A caterpillar showed up in my room the other day... Puffed up with hair, squirming... ah, just remembering it gives me chills!
